id: http://arxiv.org/abs/1310.3230v1
published: 2013-10-08T18:02:45Z
summary: The process development and optimization potential needs to be driven by the individial coporate value chain. The identification of this specific value chain and the related indicators is essential to limit the scope of any analysis and optimization to the core business The process framework consisting of clearly defined value chain, the related processes and the corresponding indicators is a pre-requisite for a meaningful and efficient process analysis and continuous process optimization.

title: Rational sphere valued supercocycles in M-theory and type IIA string theory
id: http://arxiv.org/abs/1606.03206v3
published: 2016-06-10T06:40:42Z
summary: We show that supercocycles on super $L_\infty$-algebras capture, at the rational level, the twisted cohomological charge structure of the fields of M-theory and of type IIA string theory. We show that rational 4-sphere-valued supercocycles for M-branes in M-theory descend to supercocycles in type IIA string theory with coefficients in the free loop space of the 4-sphere, to yield the Ramond-Ramond fields in the rational image of twisted K-theory, with the twist given by the B-field. In particular, we derive the M2/M5 $\leftrightarrow$ F1/Dp/NS5 correspondence via dimensional reduction of sphere-valued super-$L_\infty$-cocycles.

title: Variational Approach to Quantum Field Theory: Gaussian Approximation and the Perturbative Expansion around It
id: http://arxiv.org/abs/hep-th/9707234v2
published: 1997-07-29T07:42:59Z
summary: The functional Schrodinger picture formulation of quantum field theory and the variational Gaussian approximation method based on the formulation are briefly reviewed. After presenting recent attempts to improve the variational approximation, we introduce a new systematic method based on the background field method, which enables one to compute the order-by-order correction terms to the Gaussian approximation of the effective action.

See [the reusable kernel contract](kernel.md) for application ownership and the
non-research execution proof, and [installation boundaries](installations.md) for
independent records and runtime lifecycles. These remain inside this repository.

The local [improvement application](improvements.md) uses that same kernel contract
in an explicitly new experiment record. Captured public research informs code
proposals; it does not become writable research authority. Untrusted candidate
code runs only in restricted disposable containers, while the host scores its
outputs. An operator review receipt cannot apply code or grant release authority.

The [autonomous context lane](autonomous-context.md) is a separate WAKE application
policy on the existing per-node native authority. An installed capability permits
one selector-field change, gated by recomputed fixed-task and current-native-state
measurements. Proposal generation, adoption and rollback require no per-change
human review. Metadata events preserve research versions and history; candidate
data cannot replace the evaluator, widen permissions, modify code or create a
competing research store. Native replay owns the policy after restart.

> **Current specification.** This document explains why the present system is shaped this way: its trust boundary, durable record, governance model and known limits. Current local procedures belong in `standalone.md`; public mirror publishing belongs in `cloud.md`. Maintainer navigation, environment checks and reproducible validation guidance belong in `development.md`.
